info.title: AfterMath Alt-Data API
info.description: Public, keyless JSON over HTTPS plus a live MCP endpoint. Verified whale and retail positioning from the AfterHour social trading app, and public scoring of Telegram trade callouts. Generated from the built data files; not investment advice.

get.description: The full callout archive as CSV, one row per callout. Large file. Currently 14706 rows.
What each called option contract did after the post (5-minute trade bars), with sample sizes and coverage.

example.disclaimer: Analysis of public posts. The channels and accounts are flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud. Flag list curated by https://telegramscammers.com....

windows.intraday: Calls posted during the regular session (9:30 to 16:00 ET): the 30 minutes of 5-minute bars after the call.
windows.daily: Daily callouts (posted before the open, after the close, or on a weekend): the whole next regular session.

methodology.fill_rule: The fill is the open of the first 5-minute bar at or after the post (or the session open for daily callouts). If no trade printed within 15 minutes of the po...

rules.definition: A rule is take-profit / stop-loss measured from the fill. TP first means the take-profit level traded before the stop; SL first means the stop traded first; ...

methodology.ended_green_definition: Ended green means the last bar's close in the window was above the fill price. It is not a trading win rate.
assumptions: Every called-out contract is judged by its own traded price after the post, not by the underlying and not at expiry.
limitations: Bars are trade prints, not bid and ask. Spread and slippage are NOT modelled, so true results for someone trading these calls would be worse, most of all on ...

unscorable_by_reason.reason: illiquid: first print more than 15 minutes after the post or the open

coverage.no_bars_unknown_note: 'unknown' = the contract was not captured at all (older than the data retains, or not listed), so the call was never placed in the intraday or daily window.

delay_sensitivity.note: Re-scored from the local bar archive with the fill moved N five-minute bars after the first bar at or after the post (intraday calls only). Only calls that h...

vendor_crosscheck.note: One-off manual comparison of the Alpaca 5-minute bars (day high/low/close) with archived Yahoo daily bars. Extra prints in the Alpaca feed raise peaks and TP...

get.description: Pooled and per-channel scoring: option paths, hold-to-expiry, and forex/gold/index TP1-first vs SL-first, with Wilson 95% ranges beside every rate.

example.disclaimer: Analysis of public posts. Channels and accounts here are flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud. Flag list curated by https://telegramscammers.com...
example.source: AfterMath analysis of public Telegram channel posts against the real tape (Yahoo public bars); passive and read-only
example.conventions: rates are fractions 0..1; *_ci are Wilson 95% intervals [low, high]; option returns are percent; FX results are in R (stop distance = 1R)
example.small_sample_rule: channel or instrument rows with n under 5 are flagged small and hidden by default on the page; they remain in this file

pooled.return_unit: percent of quoted entry premium, held to expiry; -100 = expired worthless
pooled.win_definition: intrinsic value at expiry above the quoted entry premium
hold_to_expiry_assumptions: No option price history exists in the public data used here. Each option callout is scored by holding it to expiry: intrinsic value at the expiry-date close ...

paired.link_rule: exact contract match between the close post and an earlier scored open from the same channel

all_links.link_rule: contract match plus the looser same-ticker same-day match

paired.caveat: A channel's close is an early exit; the held column is the same contract held to expiry. A quoted win that would have expired worthless is a different trade,...

outcome_definitions.tp1_hit_rate: TP1 traded before the stop within 24 hours of the fill (share of market-fill signals)
outcome_definitions.sl_first_rate: the stop traded before TP1 within 24 hours (share of market-fill signals)
outcome_definitions.tp2plus_rate: TP2 traded before the stop, among signals that list two or more targets
outcome_definitions.mean_r_tp1: mean result in R (stop distance = 1R) if every trade exits at TP1 or the stop; unresolved marked to the last close
outcome_definitions.mean_r_last: mean result in R if every trade holds for the last target or the stop
outcome_definitions.breakeven_tp1_rate: 1 / (1 + average winning TP1 R): the TP1 hit rate needed to break even before costs, for resolved trades

concentration.caveat: 50 of 51 market-fill signals come from one channel (t.me/stockmarketvault) and 44 are XAUUSD; they fall in 31 same-day channel/instrument/side groups, so the...

weekly_by_channel.note: Week starts Monday (UTC); the last week may be partial. Weekly cells are small: read the range, not the point estimate.

touch_variant.note: Fill-on-touch signals: limit or stop style entries away from the market at post time, filled when price traded into the zone within 4 hours. Reported separat...

range.scope: gold, market-fill variant, across the basis assumptions in the table (excluding the no-basis row)

sensitivity.note: Each row rescored the same posts with a different assumption about the futures-to-spot basis. 'None' uses raw futures prices and is shown for completeness.

post.description: Stateless Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint. Send JSON-RPC 2.0 `tools/list` or `tools/call`. 34 tools: `get_market_tape`, `get_top_equities`, `get_etf_flows`, `get_whale_portfolio`, `get_ticker_intel`, `get_conviction_screener`, `screen_whales`, `get_shadow_whales`, `get_price_history`, `get_social_feed`, `get_funnel_accounts`, `get_funnel_callouts`, `get_funnel_tickers`, `get_funnel_scorecard`, `get_market_session`, `get_live_quotes`, `get_leaderboard`, `get_ticker_live`, `get_profile_live`, `get_post_permalink`, `get_security_chart`, `get_app_status`, `compare_tickers`, `get_retail_sentiment`, `get_retail_options_bias`, `get_retail_buzz`, `get_retail_vs_whale`, `get_sentiment_flags`, `get_ticker_posts`, `get_sentiment_trend`, `get_live_portfolio`, `get_position_changes`, `get_ticker_whale_flow`, `get_whale_sync_health`. Not a static file: this one runs the live server code.
